title: Buccaneers vs. Falcons: Initial injury report for Week 8

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Falcons: Initial injury report for Week 8
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers released their initial injury report Wednesday ahead of their Week 8 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons, with three players sitting out practice and two others participating on a limited basis. Running back Kenny Gainwell (hip), offensive tackle Luke Goedeke (calf) and linebacker Josiah Trotter (illness) were all listed as non-participants to […]
